requirements.flowDown: Before enabling student processing, the operator must bind each selected provider to the approved educational purpose, confidentiality, security, retention/deletion, incident notice, no-sale/no-profiling/no-training limits, and applicable transfer safeguards. Provider consumer terms or an app checkbox alone do not establish this.

providers.name: Cloudflare, Inc.
providers.purpose: Public-site static hosting, CDN and security
providers.data: HTTP request metadata, IP address, user agent, requested URL; no student project storage backend provided by the public site
providers.processing: Global edge network; no country-only residency promise
providers.enabled: Public sites; self-hosters select their own host
providers.transfer: Applicable Cloudflare DPA transfer clauses; operator must verify account coverage and deployment-specific requirements

providers.name: Google LLC / district Google Workspace contracting entity
providers.companyCountry: United States; actual contracting entity and selected data region depend on district agreement
providers.purpose: Optional Apps Script, Drive, Sheets, Docs, sign-in and email notifications
providers.data: Selected school records, files, account claims and family-request notices
providers.processing: District Workspace region/configuration; document exact location and backups
providers.enabled: Only selected and authorized school/cloud workflow
providers.transfer: District Workspace DPA and applicable transfer clauses; verify service and feature coverage
providers.scopes: SplatWorks office apps, AudioSplat, PDFSplat, VideoSplat, MediaSplat, MarkdownSplat, ConceptSplat and MermaidSplat direct Drive save: drive.file; Apps Script/Hub capabilities and stored records described in /legal/google-oauth-disclosure.html

providers.name: Microsoft Corporation / district Microsoft contracting entity
providers.companyCountry: United States; actual contracting entity varies
providers.data: Authorized account claims and selected project files
providers.processing: District tenant and contract region; verify selected services
providers.transfer: District Microsoft DPA and applicable transfer terms; verify actual scopes and location

providers.name: Dropbox, Inc.
providers.data: User-selected native spreadsheet file and authorization metadata
providers.processing: Provider/account configuration; district records actual location
providers.transfer: District-approved provider contract and applicable transfer safeguards required before student use

providers.name: OpenAI API contracting entity
providers.companyCountry: United States; regional contracting entities may apply
providers.data: Prompt and selected input; request metadata
providers.processing: API account configuration; approval must record retention, region and transfer basis
providers.enabled: Key stays in tab memory; separate tab approval; approved API account only
providers.transfer: Applicable business DPA/transfer clauses; school verifies no data-sharing/training opt-in and approved retention before student input

providers.name: Anthropic API contracting entity
providers.companyCountry: United States; regional contracting entities may apply
providers.data: Prompt and selected input; request metadata
providers.processing: Commercial API account configuration; record retention and region
providers.enabled: Key stays in tab memory; separate tab approval; approved API account only
providers.transfer: Applicable commercial DPA/transfer clauses; school verifies no-training configuration and approved retention before student input

providers.name: User-selected services: hosting, roster/SSO, remote media, libraries, model downloads, QR/bot endpoints and sharing recipients
providers.companyCountry: Must be recorded for each enabled service
providers.data: Selected data and request metadata; imported remote resources may contact their host
providers.processing: Must be documented before student processing
providers.enabled: Optional; no blanket approval from self-hosting or browser-only editing
providers.terms: Use the actual service contract, approved scopes, data region and provider privacy/security documentation
providers.transfer: Select applicable adequacy/SCC/UK transfer safeguards with district review; no transfer approval is implied by this register
